body: See screenshot: It should work like if we executed them one by one, we just answer each 10-15 seconds at random with starting of each separate issue link, we start only valid links, and for all invalid do summary after all valid are started. So we just have multiple tasks that are all in reply to same /codex or /claude or /solve command. We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Support multiple issues execution
